dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the lateral flank; borders exhibit high-contrast, jagged transitions from dark exterior pixels to lighter, speckled internal cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-pixel punctates located primarily on the lateral neck area and along the leading edge of the pectoral flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary scalene triangle formed by the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank, with an additional secondary linear chain of four clusters extending towards the posterior.
